---
title: "Scientific references"
---

The nonlinear PMF program is motivated by @jedamzik2025. The independent
linear, photon, and recombination tools follow @schiff2025, including the
corrected equations and implementation choices recorded in their source
provenance. These references specify related model systems; matching a shared
limit does not establish equivalence of the complete nonlinear calculations.

GLM divergence cleaning follows @dedner2002 and the HLLD flux follows
@miyoshi2005. Kernel-level modifications for cosmological clocks, stiff drag,
photon coupling, and conservation are documented in the implementation pages.

All four citation records were checked against NASA ADS when this standalone
distribution was prepared. ADS links are retained in `references.bib`.
For a result, cite the physical model, exact software revision, numerical
controls, and any supplied response table or recombination history.
